g.text: THE IMPERIAL COURT PROCLAMATION
ROYAL ARCHIVES OF AWADH • ESTD 1924
"Flavor is not what merely touches the tongue;"
"True savor is that which perfumes the soul for generations."
"A sovereign court is known by the splendor of its dastarkhwan,"
"Where every morsel recounts four centuries of royal devotion."
"In the imperial banquets of Lucknow, dining was never mere sustenance;
it was a sacred fine art where patience was the chief ingredient,
and dying embers the master painter."
"To dine at this table is to taste the timeless majesty of Indian royal heritage."
— Ustad Mir Baqir Ali • Chief Royal Khansama (Estd 1924)
VERIFIED ROYAL MASTERPIECE • 100% HERITAGE
IMPERIAL AWADH ARCHIVES
Folio 00
MENUQR ROYAL ARCHIVES • ESTD 1924
THE ROYAL DEG ARCHIVES
THE IMPERIAL DASTARKHWAN
Four Centuries of Royal Indian Hospitality
"A host's honor resides in the grace of their banquet;"
"The guest's blessing is the highest treasure of the realm."
"The culinary formulas transcribed within these folios were once inscribed
on gold-flecked vellum, scented with camphor and Kashmiri rose ittar,
and locked inside ivory chests under imperial seal.
No page was ever reprinted; every recipe was handed down with devotion.
Today, MenuQR brings this timeless artisanal majesty to your dining tables."
— THE IMPERIAL GASTRONOMIC PROTOCOL • ESTD 1924
ROYAL ARCHIVE
MQR
ESTD 1924
